caveat: MapBiomas pasture is used as a proxy for cattle-grazing land; the class records land-cover only, not verified livestock presence or off-take, so some pasture may be non-productive, fallow, or used for other grazing animals.

Mixed/alternating agriculture-and-pasture signal that MapBiomas could not resolve to a single use across the time series; no single Annex I commodity can be attributed without further field-level evidence.

Aggregated MapBiomas catch-all for annual crops other than soybean and rice (e.g. maize, cotton, sorghum, beans); none of the pooled crops are individually identifiable, and none of them is an EUDR Annex I commodity.
